pages.text: Even now, I am still hesitant on whether or not I should actually have this included in my notes. At the same time, I do see how the details I unintentionally include here may be helpful to future readers, as it may give necessary context that would be otherwise unobtainable. Well, to start, I've began my research pilgrimage half a decade ago, following the death of my family by the hands

of the joyplague. At that time, I knew very little of it. Even its name 'Risus' is something I only learned when I first spoke with a person whose body was half mutated after praying to it. Learning that it was something closer to a benevolent yet naive entity than a plague was even more of a shock... I should mention that research wasn't my original goal. I was curious, yes, but I more so wanted to know what exactly happened to my family after they engaged with the plague. With this

revelation, my goal switched to a desire to fully understand the Risus. Yet, as I delved from one ruin into the next and from one town to the other, I discovered that this plague was interconnected with the world itself - another subject that was generally barely understood, if at all. That's where I am currently, still in the middle of trying to climb multiple gigantic cliffs at the same time, hoping the peaks will give me what I seek.

Deliberating on it more, I think I'll go ahead and add addenda to my other notes as well about my personal experiences. After all, this research will be the proof of my life and achievements, so they should include my expressed view as well.
